onboarding.step1Desc: We'll help you see your complete financial picture in one place. No more switching between apps.
onboarding.step2Desc: We use read-only connections. We can never move your money. All data is encrypted end-to-end with AES-256.

onboarding.step4Desc: Link your bank accounts, brokerages, CPF, and crypto wallets. The more you connect, the better your wellness score.

analytics.title: Financial Wellness Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Deep dive into your financial health metrics
analytics.focusMessage: Focus on tax efficiency and risk management to improve your score.
analytics.tipDiversification: Your portfolio spans multiple asset classes. Consider adding international bonds for better diversification.
analytics.tipLiquidity: Good liquid coverage. You could optimize by moving some excess cash to money market funds.
analytics.tipGrowth: Strong equity exposure with good returns. Your S&P 500 ETF is your top performer.
analytics.tipRiskMgmt: Consider adding more fixed-income assets to reduce overall portfolio volatility.
analytics.tipTaxEfficiency: You're under-utilizing SRS and CPF top-ups. Significant tax savings available.
analytics.tipEmergencyFund: Well-funded emergency buffer. Consider if some excess cash could work harder elsewhere.
analytics.tipBehavioralResilience: Measures how consistently you manage your portfolio without impulsive decisions. Steady contributions and avoiding panic-selling improve this score.

insights.title: AI Insights & Coach
insights.subtitle: Personalized recommendations powered by AI analysis
insights.aiWelcome: Hi! I'm your AI financial coach. I've analyzed your portfolio and have some observations. I'll report all figures in {{currency}}. What would you like to know?
insights.chatError: Sorry, I couldn't process that. Please try again.
insights.q4: Should I invest more in ETFs?
insights.currencyNote: Monetary figures below have been converted from SGD to {{currency}} ({{symbol}}) at {{rateType}} rates (1 {{currency}} = S${{rate}}).

ins_crypto.title: Crypto Volatility Exposure
ins_crypto.summary: Your crypto allocation ({{cryptoPct}}%) carries high volatility. A 50% drawdown would reduce your net worth by ${{drawdown}}.
ins_crypto.action: Consider setting a mental stop-loss level or rebalancing 30% of crypto holdings into fixed income instruments like SSBs or T-bills.

ins_srs.title: SRS Top-Up Tax Savings Available
ins_srs.summary: You're ${{gap}} below the SRS contribution cap. Topping up could save you up to ${{taxSaving}} in taxes (at 7% marginal rate).
ins_srs.action: Transfer ${{gap}} to your SRS account before December 31st to maximize tax relief.

ins_emergency.title: Strong Emergency Fund
ins_emergency.summary: Your cash holdings cover {{months}} months of estimated expenses, exceeding the recommended 6-month buffer by ${{excess}}.
ins_emergency.action: Consider redirecting the excess ${{excess}} into higher-yield instruments like T-bills (3.5%+) or Singapore Savings Bonds.

ins_vehicle.title: Vehicle Depreciation Impact
ins_vehicle.summary: Your car is depreciating at ~{{pct}}% annually, reducing net wealth by ~${{annualLoss}}/year.
ins_vehicle.action: Factor COE renewal timeline into your financial plan. Consider if replacement vs public transport is more cost-effective long-term.

ins_equity.title: Rebalance Equity Allocation
ins_equity.summary: Your Singapore equities ({{stiPct}}%) have underperformed relative to US equities (+{{spPct}}%). Consider geographic diversification.
ins_equity.action: Review adding a global emerging markets ETF or increasing allocation to outperforming regions to reduce single-market risk.

ins_cpf.title: CPF Balances On Track
ins_cpf.summary: Your combined CPF balance of ${{cpfTotal}} is growing steadily. At current contribution rates, you're projected to meet the Basic Retirement Sum by age 55.
ins_cpf.action: Continue current contributions. Consider voluntary top-ups to SA for guaranteed 4% returns — one of the best risk-free rates available.

ins_property.title: High Property Concentration
ins_property.summary: Property makes up {{propertyPct}}% of your net worth. While common in Singapore, this creates concentration risk if the property market corrects.
ins_property.action: No immediate action needed, but gradually build up financial assets (equities, bonds) to reduce property concentration over time.

rating.subtitle: Your feedback helps us improve WealthWell.
rating.commentPlaceholder: Tell us what you love or what we can improve…
rating.thankYouMessage: Your rating has been recorded. We're constantly working to improve your experience.

profile.conservativeDesc: You prioritise stability and capital preservation. Your wellness score gives extra weight to emergency buffers, liquidity, and risk management — rewarding portfolios that stay safe in turbulent markets.
profile.balancedDesc: You seek sustainable long-term growth with manageable risk. Your wellness score balances all dimensions equally, rewarding diversification, steady contributions, and tax optimisation.
profile.growthDesc: You embrace volatility to maximise long-term capital appreciation. Your wellness score puts the most weight on growth allocation, diversification, and behavioural discipline — the hallmarks of a high-conviction investor.

risk.ageSubtitle: Your time horizon is one of the biggest factors in risk capacity.
risk.incomeQuestion: What is your approximate annual household income?
risk.incomeSubtitle: Higher income generally means a larger buffer to absorb investment losses.
risk.horizonQuestion: When do you expect to need most of this money?
risk.horizonSubtitle: Longer horizons allow you to ride out market cycles.
risk.reactionQuestion: Your portfolio drops 25% in a single month. What do you do?
risk.reactionSubtitle: Your emotional reaction to losses reveals your true risk tolerance.
risk.reactionSell: Sell everything: I cannot stomach further losses
risk.reactionReduce: Reduce exposure and move to safer assets
risk.reactionHold: Hold steady and wait for recovery
risk.reactionBuy: Buy more: I see it as a buying opportunity
risk.goalQuestion: What best describes your primary financial goal?
risk.goalSubtitle: Knowing your goal helps us align your wellness score to what matters most.
risk.goalProtect: Protect what I have, capital preservation first
risk.goalSteady: Steady long-term growth with manageable risk
risk.goalMaximise: Maximise returns, I accept significant volatility
risk.knowledgeQuestion: How would you describe your investing experience?
risk.knowledgeSubtitle: Experience tends to reduce panic during market swings.
risk.knowledgeBeginner: Beginner: I mainly use savings accounts or FDs
risk.knowledgeIntermediate: Intermediate: I invest in stocks, ETFs, or unit trusts
risk.knowledgeAdvanced: Advanced: I use options, leverage, or manage crypto actively
risk.savingsQuestion: What percentage of your monthly income goes towards long-term investments?

tour.welcomeBody: Your all-in-one financial wellness hub. Let's take 60 seconds to show you around the key features — you won't want to miss them.
tour.sidebarBody: Switch between Dashboard, Wallet, Analytics, AI Insights, Goals, Scenarios, Export and Settings from here. Each section gives you a different lens on your wealth.
tour.notifBody: This bell tracks your portfolio in real time. It alerts you when your wellness score changes, emergency funds run low, goals are hit, or your portfolio drifts — click it anytime to see what needs your attention.
tour.currencyBody: Switch your display currency here. All values across the app — net worth, assets, and charts — instantly convert using live exchange rates.
tour.feedbackBody: Spotted something? Have a suggestion? Tap this icon to send us a note directly. Your feedback shapes what we build next.
tour.coachBody: That's the Chat with Coach button — your personal AI advisor. Ask it anything about your portfolio, wellness score, or financial strategy and get instant, data-driven answers.
tour.settingsBody: Update your account, change your subscription, switch currencies, pick your language, and toggle between dark and light mode — all from here.
tour.doneBody: You know your way around WealthWell. See that ? Help button in the top-right corner? Click it anytime to replay this tour. Your AI Coach is always one tap away too.
